notes.title: Cherophobia 1.0.2 Update
notes.notes:
1. Achievements now pop instantly.
2. Fresh input prompts with device specific icons.
3. Added subtitles for lines spoken outside of the main dialogue system.
4. Increased shadow split distance in the woods.
5. ubershaders and a precaching pipeline to reduce stutter.
6. Fixed a minor issue with the Paranoia achievement.
7. Fixed a bug in yesterday’s unanounced build that could break the game during the phone call scene.
8. Various minor improvements and adjustments.

notes.title: Cherophobia 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] Trees now load instantly, eliminating previous delays.
[*] Fixed issue where curious players could reach the map’s cliff and break the game.
[*] Resolved crashing issue caused by quickly entering and exiting the house.
[*] Menu now focuses on the current language.
[*] Clarified pill-taking prompt to avoid confusion with the "drink" prompt.
[*] Lowered volume of dial-up sound for a more balanced audio experience.
[/olist]
